output.question: Where can I find JPMorgan Chase's latest annual report?
output.answer: JPMorgan Chase's latest annual report covers fiscal 2025. The firm published it, along with the shareholder letters from Chairman & CEO Jamie Dimon and other business heads, on April 6, 2026. The release says the report and letters are on the Investor Relations website at jpmorganchase.com/ir/annual-report. The 2025 page there is jpmorganchase.com/ir/annual-report/2025, and the CEO letter is at /ir/annual-report/2025/ar-ceo-letters. A full PDF (about 4.7 MB) is at jpmorganchase.com/content/dam/jpmc/jpmorgan-chase-and-co/investor-relations/documents/annualreport-2025.pdf. The 2026 report would normally come out around April 2027, so the 2025 edition should still be the latest as of November 2026.

key_facts.fact: On April 6, 2026, JPMorganChase published its 2025 Annual Report, including letters to shareholders from its Chairman & CEO and other business heads.
The Annual Report and letters are on the firm's Investor Relations website at jpmorganchase.com/ir/annual-report.
The IR site has a 2025 Annual Report page (Investor Relations > Annual Report > 2025) with a link to the Chairman and CEO Letter to Shareholders at /ir/annual-report/2025/ar-ceo-letters.
A PDF of the 2025 annual report (about 4.7 MB) is hosted on jpmorganchase.com.

passages.quote: has published its 2025 Annual Report, including letters to shareholders from its Chairman & CEO and other business heads.
The Annual Report and letters are now available on the Firm's Investor Relations website at jpmorganchase.com/ir/annual-report.
Chairman and CEO Letter to Shareholders

caveats: The PDF is compressed, so I couldn't read its cover text to check it. I'm going by the URL (annualreport-2025.pdf) and the fact that it's on JPMorganChase's own site.
The company's own IR news release and the Business Wire originals returned HTTP 403, so I quoted the release from a syndicated copy (Observer-Reporter).

The full financial statements are also in the Form 10-K for fiscal 2025, which is on SEC EDGAR and the IR site under SEC Filings. The 10-K press release returned HTTP 403, so I couldn't confirm the filing date (search results suggest February 2026).
The 2026 annual report should come out around April 2027. After that, the 2025 report will no longer be the latest.
